messages:
ellie: noticed a bump in compat.fallback_rate after last night's rollout. many v1 clients got routed to v2 shim.
sam: saw that too. looks correlated with the new `header_coercion` change. some SDKs send 'v1.0' vs 'v1' and our scorer treated them as different.
ana: quick glance at routing rules: fallback_threshold set to 0.94 and prefer_v2=false. small header entropy causes flips.
michael: short-term: propose adding `fallback_smoothing` config (ema window 30s) and a per-tenant "lenient-compat" flag to reduce false positives.
ellie: agree. ops wants a preview on console before committing changes so support can see impact.
sam: backend: add POST /api/rollouts/preview that simulates fallback_rate with smoothing + lenient flag using last 5m of headers. return preview metrics tagged preview=true.
ana: frontend: add a toggle "Enable smoothing" and radio "Compatibility mode: strict | lenient | shadow" with a preview button. tooltip: "Lenient accepts minor header variants to avoid noisy fallbacks."
ops-bot: deploy log: "routing-service v3.2.5 -> added preview endpoint" at 03:12 UTC. monitoring preview metrics now.
michael: follow-ups: ana -> implement scorer OR-match for raw/normalized headers; sam -> add per-tenant flag and smoothing; nana -> add UI toggle + preview; ellie -> coordinate with support to mute customer banners for affected tenants for 2h.
ellie: will mute banners for tenants in the pilot. reconvene in 30m to judge whether to promote smoothing to beta cohort.
